limitations: Finite teaching state machine, not Broker, Java runtime, filesystem durability or notification-provider experiment.
Encoded bytes are the model JSON value only; Kafka batch overhead and offset deltas are not emulated.
No commit/recovery, idempotence, replication or real notification side effects are tested.
